description: Return extendable delegations for a receiver plus an `extendData` payload for the extension flow. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Use as STEP 1 before `tronsave_internal_create_extend_request` when the user wants to extend existing delegation time. Read-only; does not submit anything. FRESHNESS: pricing/availability change within seconds — run immediately before extending and pass the returned `extendData` unchanged.

extendTo.description: Target end time as Unix epoch SECONDS (UTC) for the extended delegation, e.g. now + 86400 for one more day. Milliseconds are rejected by TronSave (INVALID_EXTEND_TIME).

maxPriceAccepted.description: Maximum unit price in SUN you are willing to pay for the extension.

receiver.description: TRON base58 address of the account that receives the delegated resource.

requester.description: TRON base58 requester; defaults to the API key account when omitted.

resourceType.description: Resource type. Default ENERGY when omitted.
